maddeler.e:
أمتهن (form VIII)
# أَمْتَهِنُ (ʔamtahinu) /ʔam.ta.hi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَهَنَ (imtahana)
# أَمْتَهِنَ (ʔamtahina) /ʔam.ta.hi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَهَنَ (imtahana)
# أَمْتَهِنْ (ʔamtahin) /ʔam.ta.hin/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِمْتَهَنَ (imtahana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
